extDescription: Save job posts from any page to your Mui Resume job board. Public pool is free when jobs are found; private saves stay yours.
tagline: Save the jobs on this page
setupBody: Create an API key at {0} and paste it here. It is stored only in this browser.
keyInvalidFormat: The API key starts with mui_ and is 36 characters long
unsupportedPage: Open a regular web page (built-in browser pages can't be read).
pageBlocked: This page doesn't allow extensions to read it: {0}
hintPublicRest: — duplicates too. New jobs earn {0}+ tokens. If no job is found, the actual AI usage is charged (up to {1}, held first, the rest refunded).
hintPrivate: Private saves are visible only to you and never enter the public pool. Charged by actual AI usage, up to {0} tokens (held first, the rest refunded); usually 0 for pages with structured data or Greenhouse / Lever / Ashby jobs.
queuedNote: This can take up to a minute. You can close the popup — reopen it to see the result.
noJobsDefault: This page doesn't look like a job post.
errKey: Your sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.
errBalance: Not enough balance. Top up at muicv.com/dashboard.
errRate: Too many submissions. Please try again shortly.
errTimeout: Still processing. Reopen the popup later to see the result.
setupLead: Sign in on muicv.com and the extension connects automatically.
loginFailed: Sign-in was cancelled or failed. Please try again.
signOutNote: Signing out removes the key from this browser. You can revoke it under API keys in the dashboard.
